message.content:
Fix two lint failures in Task 4's `apps/birdseye/internal/archive/extract.go` in worktree `/Users/steve.briggs/projects/operations/.claude/worktrees/birdseye`.

## Lint Failures to Fix

### Fix 1: `nolintlint` requires explanation

In `apps/birdseye/internal/archive/extract.go`, the line:

```go
case tar.TypeReg, tar.TypeRegA: //nolint:staticcheck
```

(or wherever the `//nolint:staticcheck` comment is) needs an explanation. Change it to:

```go
case tar.TypeReg, tar.TypeRegA: //nolint:staticcheck // TypeRegA is the legacy '\x00' form of TypeReg still emitted by some older tar implementations
```

### Fix 2: `intrange` on both index loops

In `apps/birdseye/internal/archive/extract.go`, both `safePath` and `containsDotDot` use C-style index loops. Convert to `range len(...)`:

In `safePath`:
```go
for i := 0; i < len(name); i++ {
    if name[i] == '\\' {
```
becomes:
```go
for i := range len(name) {
    if name[i] == '\\' {
```

In `containsDotDot`:
```go
for i := 0; i < len(p); i++ {
    if p[i] != '.' {
```
becomes:
```go
for i := range len(p) {
    if p[i] != '.' {
```

## Verify

After edits:

- [ ] `cd /Users/steve.briggs/projects/operations/.claude/worktrees/birdseye/apps/birdseye && go test -race ./internal/archive/... -v` — all 3 tests still pass.
- [ ] `cd /Users/steve.briggs/projects/operations/.claude/worktrees/birdseye/apps/birdseye && go vet ./...` — clean.
- [ ] If a `golangci-lint` binary is available in PATH, run `cd /Users/steve.briggs/projects/operations/.claude/worktrees/birdseye && golangci-lint run apps/birdseye/internal/archive/...` to confirm `intrange` and `nolintlint` now pass. If `golangci-lint` is NOT installed, skip this check — `go vet` is sufficient signal.

## Commit

```bash
cd /Users/steve.briggs/projects/operations/.claude/worktrees/birdseye && git add apps/birdseye/internal/archive/extract.go && git commit -m "style(birdseye): satisfy intrange and nolintlint for archive package"
```

- What was edited

- Whether golangci-lint was run (and result if so)
- Commit SHA
